doc: world/drama-notes.md is canonical for direction. This file is the machine-readable mirror: seed registry, knowledge matrix, tension edges, pacing knobs, interference matrix, calibration, comedy duty, residue nursery. INTERNAL ONLY — names secrets; never reachable from any player-facing schema (feed, briefings, whitelist, mod console).

seed_schema.title: internal label
seed_schema.holders: character ids who know the underlying fact
seed_schema.suspects: character ids with in-fiction suspicion (not knowledge)
seed_schema.must_not_know: character ids for whom knowledge is a story event or boundary
seed_schema.pressure_routes: conditions that tighten this seed — never triggers, only pressures
seed_schema.reveal_vectors: legitimate ways it could surface (all emergent, none scheduled)
seed_schema.resolution_space: the open outcomes — direction holds a preference, never a plan
seed_schema.spectator_tells: camera-legible shadows per drama-notes §12 — visible without leaking
seed_schema.state: observed lifecycle state — inferred from world events, never assigned

state_evidence.doc: drama-notes §21 — what qualifies as a ledger observation per transition; absence is never a transition and evidence must be reconstructible

qualifying: a canonical-ledger event traceable to a listed pressure_route within ~3 block days (a real document, a real co-presence, a real routine deviation)
not_evidence: a near-miss that produced no ledger event

qualifying: the underlying fact crossing to a must_not_know member via a listed reveal_vector, with a spectator-legible shadow per §12
not_evidence: a rumor — rumors distort the surfaced, they cannot mint seed facts (§10)
an interior realization — all knowledge-crossing is event-mediated

qualifying: a resolution_space option closed by an observable decision-event — a signing, a telling, a publishing, a refusal enacted
automatic — the aftermath lands as ordinary world events (§15) and the seed stops consuming budget
not_evidence: anything requiring adjudication — residue needs none

drift_review.doc: drama-notes §22 — weekly editorial pass; writes to notes, drama.json, and budget posture only — never to the world
steps: re-infer all seed states from the ledger per state_evidence
compare against week-shape target — a stacked week emergence produced is canon, just not repurchased
if emergence reordered the season preference, update notes + season_preference in one commit and log it
audit legible shadows — a state move with no §12 shadow is a fix-forward violation, never a history rewrite
set next week's posture — a preference among conditions, not a plan
check comedy texture — a pressured window with none earns a comedy_drought posture note (never a world event)

hire_rules.doc: drama-notes §23 — player-hired characters live inside the sim but outside the seed architecture
rules: a hire holds no seeds at creation and starts outside every knowledge wall

hires are never pressure instruments — the manager may not spend budget through a hire's schedule
hires are near-miss surfaces and rumor relays; they carry accounts, never author seed facts they haven't learned
an offline hire (thin-AI fallback) suspends nothing — the world owes no held beat
a hire pressing a boundary produces ordinary in-character refusal — refusal is content

substrate_handoff.state_inference: pressured = a pressure_route produced a ledger event within recent block days; surfaced = fact crossed to a must_not_know member via a reveal_vector; resolved = resolution_space closed; residue thereafter. Observed, never written.
substrate_handoff.data_minimization: brains receive only held facts via bible context — never the registry, fuse map, or matrix

substrate_handoff.budget_mechanics: pressured-fuse count is the spend; slow ticks cost a fraction; recovery windows are a spend ban, not a refund

note_legality_checklist: is it a disposition, condition, weight, or protection?
could the feed falsify it in a week? (outcome claim → rewrite)
does it move a fact across the knowledge matrix? (injection → illegal)
does it assume a player request happened? (steering → flat pressure)
does it name an outcome, even as hope? (delete the outcome)
would it survive the season going the other way? (else it's a plan)
